results.title: School admissions: How to apply
results.content:
### Applying for a primary school place

You must apply for a primary school place a year before your child can start school. The school starting age is 4. 

Your child will be 3 or have just turned 4 when you apply.

This is true even if you want your child to start later - you’ll be able to ask for a later start when you apply. 

Applications open in September each year and close on 15 January.

results.title: Apply for a reception or year 3 place at a primary school
results.content:
- Your child must be in full-time education at the beginning of the term following his or her fifth birthday. If your child was born between 1 September 2022 and 31 August 2023 they are due to start primary school in September 2027.
- If your child is in year 2 from September 2026 at an infant school in Devon, they are due to transfer to junior school in September 2027
- Applications for starting primary or junior school in September 2027 open on 15 November 2026 and close on 15 January 2027.

The date that all allocations of school places are announced in England is known as ‘offer day’. For September 2027 primary school starters this will be on 16 April 2027. More information can be found in the offer day section below.

...

The application system to apply for a reception place at primary/infant schools and year 3 at junior schools in September 2027 opens on 15 November 2026, and you can apply online at the Citizens Portal.

The closing date is 15 January 2027. You can apply after this date but applications will be considered late and may be at a disadvantage. Please see the ‘Late applications’ tab for more information.

You cannot apply online after the closing date, so please contact the Education helpline on 0345 155 1019 (03451551019) and ask for a paper copy of the form to be sent to you.
- Late applications

Applications close on 15 January each year. If you apply after this date, the application will be considered late unless you can demonstrate that you were unable to apply on time, for example, because of illness or a house move. For illness to be taken into account, it must have prevented an application being made.

results.title: Primary school places | Essex County Council
results.content:
Apply for a primary (reception) school place for September 2027

You can apply for primary (reception) school place at an Essex primary school between 9 November 2026 to 15 January 2027.

...

## Apply

Apply online for your child’s primary (reception) school place.

Please ensure that your online application is submitted by 15 January 2027. Remember to re-submit after making any changes before the deadline.

All applications received after 15 January will be treated as late and will only be processed after all on-time applications.

results.title: Apply for a reception or junior place for September 2027 - Derby City Council
results.content:

### Reception intake and junior transfer

results.title: Admission to Reception at Primary School/Year 3 Junior School & Lower to Middle school places for September 2027 | Gloucestershire County Council
results.content:
The online Parent Portal is now open for Admission to Reception applications, Transfer to Junior school applications and from Lower School to Middle School applications for September 2027 

Please note: We are operating a new Parent Portal system for school admissions. As a result, all parents/carers will need to register as a new user on this portal to submit their September 2027 application. Login details from the previous Parent Portal will not work on the new portal.

...

The online application facility is the preferred method for most parents/carers as it allows them to receive an email ... However, should you be unable to use it, you can download a paper application form in the related documents column and return this to us.

It is extremely important that you submit your application by midnight, 15 January 2027.

...

## Key dates

| From November 2026 | Letters sent out to Gloucestershire residents making them aware the online application window is open. However you do not need the letter to make the application |
| --- | --- |
| From 5 November 2026 to Midnight 15 January 2027 | Application Window. Closing date for school applications is Midnight on 15 January 2027 |
| 16 April 2027 | Allocation Day |
| 23 April 2027 | Closing date to return reply form accepting the School/Academy place or requesting to be put on waiting list/s |
| By 19 May 2027 | Outcome of Waiting List Requests |
| Midnight 26 May 2027 | Closing date for return of reply forms |
| Late June 2027 to July 2027 | Appeals |

...

Parents can apply online 24 hours a day, seven days a week from November until midnight on 15 January or by completing a paper form which can be downloaded from the same site or requested from the county council's Co-ordinated Admissions on 01452 425407.
